title: Chroma
tagline: Red and green make yellow. Yellow and blue make trouble.
description: A merge game where the merges follow light rather than arithmetic. Tiles that share no colour combine into their mixture — red and green into yellow, yellow and blue into white — and two whites collapse into a prism that takes a whole row with it. Because mixing is a branching graph rather than a doubling ladder, there is rarely one correct move: cash the yellows in now, or hold the blues for something better. Everyone gets the same tile order each day.
author: HexCave
howToPlay: Drop tiles into columns. Colours that share nothing mix.
Red and green make yellow; two whites clear a row.
Same colours never merge, so a board of one colour is trouble.
goal: Score as much as you can before the grid fills. Chains are where the points are — a merge that triggers another is worth far more than two separate ones.

1.1.0.notes: In-game coaching: short hints that appear where they are relevant and retire once you have got it.
